description: A tabbed dock beside the chat for a shell, Git changes and other mods' panels, with focus keys, resize keys, screen modes and a panel registry

keybinding.title: Key overrides
keybinding.description: Action to key, or <disabled>: panel_1 to panel_9, main, left, left_alt, right, right_alt, next, help, mode_next, mode_previous, tab_previous, tab_next, panel_tab_previous, panel_tab_next, grow, shrink, focus_shell

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: mode (tabs or stack), panels (ids), side (right or left), ratio ([panels, chat]) and portrait (columns below which the panels move below or above the chat)
